notIssued.title: Certificates are not being issued by this academy yet
notIssued.description: When the academy starts issuing them, every course you complete that awards one shows its certificate here.

empty.title: No certificates yet
empty.description: Complete a course that awards one and it appears here.

card.copyFailed: Could not copy — select the text and copy it yourself.
card.downloadHint: Each download fetches a fresh link that stays valid for one hour.
card.preparingHint: The PDF is being rendered. Refresh in a moment.
card.failed: The PDF could not be prepared — contact the academy.
card.revokedNoDownload: A revoked certificate can no longer be downloaded.

overview.none: No certificates yet — complete a course that awards one and it appears here.

verify.title: Verify a certificate
verify.subtitle: Check that a certificate was issued by this academy and has not been revoked.

invalid.title: This code does not match any certificate
invalid.description: Check the characters and try again. Codes use letters and digits only; the letters I, L and O are never used.

valid.title: Valid certificate
valid.description: This certificate was issued by the academy named below and is still in force.

revoked.title: This certificate was revoked on {{date}}
revoked.description: The academy withdrew it. It should no longer be relied on.

error.title: The code could not be checked
error.description: The verification service did not answer. Try again in a moment.

staff.title: Certificates
staff.subtitle: Every certificate this academy has issued, with the actions the audit trail records.
staff.readOnly: You can view certificates. Issuing, revoking and regenerating are for the academy's owner and managers.

empty.title: No certificates yet
empty.description: Certificates appear here when a learner completes a course that awards one, or when you issue one from a learner's enrollment.

noMatch.title: No certificates match
noMatch.description: Change the status or course filter to see more.

detail.title: Certificate {{serial}}
detail.description: Everything recorded at issuance. These facts do not change when the learner retakes a quiz.
detail.downloadHint: The link stays valid for one hour after opening this dialog.

revoke.title: Revoke certificate {{serial}}
revoke.description: The certificate stays listed and its verification page shows it as revoked. The learner can no longer download it. This cannot be undone.
revoke.reasonPlaceholder: Why this certificate is being withdrawn — recorded in the audit trail.

regenerate.title: Regenerate certificate {{serial}}
regenerate.description: A new version of the PDF is produced from the current template and the learner's current name. The serial and the verification code stay the same; the score and dates recorded at issuance do not change.
regenerate.reasonPlaceholder: For example: the academy logo changed.

issue.title: Issue a certificate
issue.description: Issues a certificate for {{course}} to {{name}} now. Use it when the completion rule was met outside Atlas or an automatic issuance did not happen.
issue.force: Issue even if the completion rule is not met
issue.forceHint: The certificate records the learner's current score, whatever it is. Owners and managers only.

template.title: Certificate template
template.subtitle: The academy identity and wording printed on every certificate. Already-issued certificates keep their version until you regenerate them.
template.readOnly: Only the academy's owner and managers can change the template.

fields.name: Template name
fields.logoHint: Printed at the top of the certificate. Choose from the academy media library.
fields.wordingHint: The learner's name, the course and the completion date are printed by the layout; the body introduces them.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: How the wording reads on the standard layout. The footer is fixed.

toast.savedDescription: New certificates use it from now on.
